items.title: 9.8.3 How to Foster Innovation and Creativity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of fostering innovation (PDF 222-223).

items: Mutajassis rahein: sawal karein aur dekhein cheezein kaise chalti hain; tajassus jiddat ka pehla qadam hai.
Khatra uthayein: nayi cheezein aazmayein chahe pehli baar nakam hon; kai jiddatein nakami se seekhne se aati hain.
Roayati soch se hat kar: masail ko mukhtalif zawiyon se dekhein.
Tawun: doosron ke saath kaam naye khayalat jagata hai.

blocks.text: Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke pehli online Urdu lughat ek Pakistani mojid ne banayi (Did You Know); yeh daawa chhape mutabiq diya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: groups mein college ya community ke kisi masle ke takhleeqi hal soch kar pesh karein. Ek tajweez dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan canteen ki lambi qataaron ke liye: pehle se order ki sheet ya messaging group ta ke khana waqfe par tayyar ho. Yeh tajweez wazahati hai.

items: Jiddat ki parwarish: tajassus, khatra uthana, naye zawiye, tawun.
